师徒两人进入院子，平三卓就迫不及待的领着王野来到书房，把一本本医书放在桌子上。

小老头视若珍宝般拿起医书，轻轻的摩挲着那泛黄的封面，书页边缘有些破损，他眉头微皱眼中满是疼惜。

整个房间安静极了，只有平三卓翻书声和轻轻的叹息声。他完全沉浸在医书的世界里，忘记了时间的流逝。王野看着师父的这种状态，悄悄的退出房间，跟师娘打过声招呼就回家了。

回到家中，一院子的人引起了王野的注意：“大哥，大姐，你们怎么来了？”

从不远处跑来一个小女孩儿：“哥哥，哥哥，还有我。”

王野蹲下身，抚摸着小女孩的脑袋：“呦，悦悦也来啦？”

秦天悦跟王野还是有些拘谨的，王笑笑可不会，踉踉跄跄的就直接扑进了王野怀里。

秦天熙上前一步：“小野，我们是专程来找你的。”

王野疑惑的看着他，那意思就是：“你怎么知道我回来了？”

秦天熙被王野看得有点儿不太自在：“别误会啊，昨天周鑫找我去了。”

“咋滴，我没怎么他呀，怎么还找家长了？”

秦天熙：“找什么家长呀，就是去证实一下你是不是我弟弟，这要是让人忽悠了，他也不用在这个圈子里混了，太丢人了。”

王野点点头问道：“大哥，你这么急找我有什么事儿啊”

秦天熙：“我能有什么事儿啊？你舅舅找你。”

王野疑惑的问道：“大哥，舅舅一个大将军，一天天的总盯着我干嘛？”

秦天熙笑骂道：“你个臭小子，我爸那是关心你，你还抱怨上了。”

王野：“大哥，这都天黑了，不用现在就去吧？”

“不用，你舅舅说让你明天中午去家里吃饭。”

王野想了一下：“那我明天早点过去，中午饭我做就行了。”

秦天韵听见王野说要做饭，赶紧上前：“弟弟，你要做什么好吃的呀？”

王野：“也没啥，这次去东北弄了点儿飞龙和榛蘑，做个飞龙炖榛蘑，再做个清蒸哈士蟆，还有道大菜明天再说。”

秦天韵的好奇心都被勾起来了，怎么可能轻易放过王野。就这样，姐弟两个在院里闹了起来，秦婉看着自己的侄子侄女能和儿子玩到一起，也很欣慰。

一直闹到很晚，秦家兄妹才走，秦天悦是不想走的，最后还是大姐搬出他母亲，她才乖乖跟着走了。他们走后，王野先去了赵爷爷屋，把今天平三卓的话，原原本本的学了一遍。

赵爷爷：“到头来居然沾了你小子的光，这真是命啊！谁能想到，当时的阴错阳差认识了你们一家，反而是我成了这场缘分中的最大受益者。”

As soon as the master and apprentice entered the courtyard, Ping Sanzhuo couldn't wait to lead Wang Ye to the study room and put medical books on the table.

The little old man picked up the medical book as if it were a treasure and gently rubbed the yellowed cover. The edges of the pages were somewhat damaged. His brows were slightly furrowed and his eyes were filled with pity.

The whole room was extremely quiet, except for the sound of Ping Sanzhuo turning the book and sighing softly.He was completely immersed in the world of medical books and forgot the passage of time.Seeing his master's state, Wang Ye quietly exited the room, said hello to his master's wife and went home.

Back home, a group of people in the yard caught Wang Ye's attention: "Brother, eldest sister, why are you here?"

A little girl ran from not far away: "Brother, brother, and me."

Wang Ye knelt down and stroked the little girl's head: "Hey, Yueyue is here too?"

Qin Tianyue and Wang Ye were still a little reserved, but Wang Xiaoxiao was not that good at it. He staggered and threw himself into Wang Ye's arms.

Qin Tianxi took a step forward: "Xiaoye, we came here specifically to see you."

Wang Ye looked at him doubtfully, meaning: "How did you know I was back?"

Qin Tianxi felt a little uncomfortable being looked at by Wang Ye: "Don't get me wrong, Zhou Xin came to see me yesterday."

"Why, I don't have anything to do with him, so why are I still looking for my parents?"

Qin Tianxi: "What parent are you looking for? I just want to confirm whether you are my brother. If someone is deceived, he won't have to hang out in this circle. It's too embarrassing."

Wang Ye nodded and asked: "Brother, why are you so anxious to see me?"

Qin Tianxi: "What can happen to me? Your uncle is looking for you."

Wang Ye asked in confusion: "Brother, why is my uncle, a great general, always staring at me every day?"

Qin Tianxi laughed and scolded: "You brat, my dad cares about you, but you still complain."

Wang Ye: "Brother, it's already dark, so you don't need to go now, right?"

"No, your uncle asked you to go home for dinner at noon tomorrow."

Wang Ye thought for a moment: "Then I'll go there early tomorrow and I'll just make lunch."

Qin Tianyun heard Wang Ye saying that he wanted to cook, and hurried forward: "Brother, what are you going to make delicious?"

Wang Ye: "It's nothing. This time I went to the Northeast to get some dragon and hazel mushrooms. I'll make a dragon stewed hazel mushroom and steamed hash browns. There's also a big dish to be cooked tomorrow."

Qin Tianyun's curiosity was aroused, how could he let Wang Ye go so easily.In this way, the two siblings started making trouble in the courtyard. Qin Wan was very happy to see her nephew and niece playing together with her son.

The quarrel lasted until very late before the Qin brothers and sisters left. Qin Tianyue didn't want to leave. In the end, the eldest sister moved out and his mother followed her.After they left, Wang Ye went to Grandpa Zhao's house first and learned Ping Sanzhuo's words today exactly.

Grandpa Zhao: "In the end, I ended up in your boy's favor. What a fate! Who would have thought that I met your family by chance at that time, and I became the biggest beneficiary of this fate."
